name: Leadfeeder
description:
Leadfeeder shows you which companies are visiting your website and how well they fit your ideal customer. Connect Leadfeeder to Claude and just ask: find the right-fit companies showing interest this week, see what they viewed, enrich them with the right contacts, build and tag lists, and check your usage — all in plain language. Start from the demand your website already creates, not a cold database. You sign in with your own Leadfeeder account and stay in control of what the assistant can do.

Leadfeeder provides business contact data from its B2B database, built from publicly available sources. The legal basis for processing this personal data is Leadfeeder's legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) in providing and marketing our services to our users and clients. Individuals can request removal, object to processing, or opt out at https://privacycockpit.leadfeeder.com/ or by contacting privacy@leadfeeder.com. More information available on our Privacy Center: https://www.leadfeeder.com/privacy/privacy-center/

_published_faq.name: How do I add Leadfeeder to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Leadfeeder to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.leadfeeder.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Leadfeeder MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Leadfeeder lists 58 MCP tools, including add_company_to_lists, add_contact_to_lists, assign_tags_to_company, create_company_enrichment_job, create_custom_field, create_find_contact_data_job, create_list, create_tag, create_web_visits_custom_feed, delete_custom_field, delete_list, and delete_tag.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Leadfeeder?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Leadfeeder in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Leadfeeder requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Leadfeeder is developed by Leadfeeder. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
